_comment: Mirrors /etc/waybeam-link/ground.json on the ground at 192.168.2.242, re-read from the node 2026-08-21. SINGLE 8812AU on bus 8-1 as the TX/RX combo (operator rule) - RadioAir's role:'tx' adapter is duplex and also receives, so no second adapter is paired for the ground role; the 8812CU diversity entry this file used to carry is gone. Devourer (air.kind radio); whole-frame SHM egress. Since 2026-08-16 the link runs IN-PROCESS inside waybeam_hub (mod_wblink, wblink.config_path in /etc/waybeam_hub/waybeam_ground.conf points here) — there is no standalone waybeam-link on this node, so a config change takes a waybeam-hub.service restart.

adapters._power_comment: §10.5 offset space. 8812AU uplink floor MEASURED at the craft 2026-08-16: 0/-24/-48/-72 qdb read -45/-50/-56/-63 dBm (exactly 0.25 dB/qdB), -96 reports saturated_low true and -128 clamps to -126. 18 dB of travel; the ladder's existing bottom rung IS the floor. The ground's own receive RSSI held -56 throughout — the control that says only its TX moved. BENCH-LOW for 50 cm geometry — raise before any range or flight test.
adapters.name: au-uplink
adapters._bus_comment: Re-measured on the node 2026-08-21 (lsusb -t): the 8812AU is on bus 8-1. This file said 5-1 while the node ran 8-1 — USB bus paths shuffle on re-plug, so read the node, never carry the path over.

streams._conceal_comment: §6.3b spatial salvage — ARMED here first because this is the ground whose decode path is verified end to end: a repaired stream decodes bit-identically on ffmpeg and on this host's AMD vah265dec, while an unrepaired gap AU does not (findings 2026-08-20). 'off' restores pre-§6.3b behaviour bit-for-bit. freeze_frame stays on: the hub's MPP default presents errinfo frames and fires the IDR requester on a drop, so freezing is cheaper than dropping. Phase C measured MPP on the rk3566 ground 2026-08-21 — it accepts a repair (89 dB vs ffmpeg over 2 CTU rows) and disagrees at 39 dB on the gap it replaces — so that ground carries the same key set to slice-skip. NOTE this key only reached THIS node's running process on 2026-08-21: the binary here was a pre-§6.3b build until then, and the file having the key is not the node having it.

streams._comment: §7.5 uplink RC ingress — hub telemetry.udp_target points here
downlink FC telemetry delivery — into the ground hub's UDP bind

csa._adjacent_guard_comment: §11 quick-connect guard, on the node since 2026-08-16: refuse a claim whose channel sits within 40 MHz of another emitter the scout measured. It is not a substitute for planning separation — it can only see emitters the scout saw — and two crafts in the air still need 60 MHz between them (findings 2026-08-16).
